findings.rule: The private key goes to `«secrets»/RELEASE_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY.pem` (mode 0600), the file the credentials sync already reads.
findings.input: A new org: `pandoscope org release-bot ada --meta M` followed by the first `pandoscope org init ada --meta M --project p --description d --approver a` (no bot flags), with the default secrets directory M/.secrets/orgs/ada absent before the first command.
findings.finding: `store` creates the secrets directory, so the first `org init` that follows sees `secrets.exists()` true in `reconcile` (reconcile.py:89) and skips the `sync-gh-actions-credentials.sh --seed` step; the org's credentials sync then runs with no state snapshot and no placeholders for LABELS_TOKEN, PUSH_BLOCKLIST or PROJECT_BOARD_TOKEN, unlike the same init run without a prior `org release-bot`.

findings.rule: `org init` without `--release-bot-app` and `--release-bot-client-id` uses the app `release-bot.json` records, so the flags become optional after `org release-bot`.
findings.input: `pandoscope org init --help` after `org release-bot` has recorded an app.
findings.finding: The `--release-bot-app` help still says "without it, credentials are skipped", while the change makes `org init` without the flag use the recorded app and render credentials.
